The Dogecoin Foundation, through its newly formed business arm, has established an “Official Dogecoin Reserve” and purchased the first 10 million DOGE (about $1.8 million) at current market prices.

Nasdaq has submitted an application to the U.S. SEC to list and trade the 21Shares Dogecoin ETF under Nasdaq Rule 5711(d). The ETF will be sponsored by 21Shares US LLC and is designed to track the performance of Dogecoin.
